name: Iran

system.type: Two-round direct presidential vote; supreme leader chosen by the 88-member Assembly of Experts

wildFacts.text: On 8 March 2026 the Assembly of Experts named Mojtaba Khamenei supreme leader after his father was killed in US-Israeli strikes.
The 2024 runoff count included more than 1 million invalid votes.

notes: All figures officially reported (Iran election headquarters, via RFE/RL). First-round turnout officially ~40% (RFE/RL) / 39% (Guardian), a record low. 2026 leadership change confirmed by two sources: BBC and Al Jazeera (https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/8/iran-names-khameneis-son-as-new-supreme-leader-after-fathers-killing-2).
